test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the city of Ahmedabad is NOT true?

options.text: The first mill in Ahmedabad was established in the year 1895.
Ahmedabad is located on the banks of the river Sabarmati.
Ahmedabad was often referred to as the 'Manchester of India'.
Ahmedabad is situated very close to cotton growing areas.

solution:
The correct answer is **__The first mill in Ahmedabad was established in the year 1895.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The first cotton mill established in Ahmedabad was in the year 1861, which later emerged as a rival centre to Mumbai's textile mill.
 
• Ahmedabad is located on the banks of the river Sabarmati.
 
• Ahmedabad is called the Manchester of India because of its similarity with the famous cotton textile centre of Manchester, Great Britain.
 
• Ahmedabad is situated very close to cotton-growing areas.
 
• **Hence Option 1 is NOT true, so correct.**
